name: Brand Guidelines
tagline: Apply Anthropic's official brand colors and typography to artifacts — visual identity and styling.
description: Applies Anthropic's official brand identity and style resources to any artifact. Includes official brand colors (dark #141413, light #faf9f5, mid gray #b0aea5, light gray #e8e6dc, orange #d97757, blue #6a9bcc, green #788c5d), typography guidelines (Poppins for headings, Lora for body text), smart font application with fallbacks, text styling with color selection based on background, and shape/accent color cycling. Maintains visual consistency and brand fidelity across all artifacts.
author: anthropics
